title.zh: CoinDCX 热钱包疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT，交易所事后确认安全事件
title.en: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】

current_state.zh: CoinDCX 已正式确认 1599 万 USDT 损失源于被弃用的旧钱包基础设施及自动归集服务失效，并称损失由公司承担、当前系统未受影响；Salus 首席营销官公开质疑其说法。
current_state.en: CoinDCX has formally confirmed that the 15.99 million USDT loss stemmed from deprecated wallet infrastructure and a failed automatic sweeping service, saying it will absorb the loss and that current systems were unaffected; Salus's CMO publicly disputes that account.

updates.title_zh: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】
updates.title_en: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】
updates.what_changed_zh: Salus 首席营销官报告称，10 月 21 日约有 1599 万 USDT 和 5,783.81 TRX 从 CoinDCX 热钱包和充值地址转出至一个 TRON 地址，随后资金被拆分并转往 Binance、OKX 和 Gate 的充值地址，此事被描述为疑似盗窃。
updates.what_changed_en: Salus's CMO reported that roughly 15.99 million USDT and 5,783.81 TRX moved out of CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a TRON address on October 21, with the funds subsequently split and transferred toward Binance, OKX and Gate deposit addresses, in what is being described as a suspected theft.

updates.background_zh: CoinDCX在2025年7月披露一起4400万美元被盗事件，起因是一名软件工程师用于兼职工作的公司笔记本电脑被入侵。平台称2025年1月创建的相关钱包地址在该事件中遭到入侵，此后CoinDCX已不再使用。随后有链上调查人员标记了约1600万美元的可疑资金转移，涉及据称与该交易所相关的地址。
updates.background_en: CoinDCX disclosed a $44 million hack in July 2025 that followed the compromise of a software engineer's company laptop used for side work. The exchange says wallet addresses created in January 2025 were compromised in that incident and have not been used by CoinDCX since. Blockchain investigators subsequently flagged roughly $16 million in suspicious movements tied to addresses said to be associated with the exchange.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这场争议使市场持续关注交易所的托管流程与存款地址管理，这一渠道可能影响印度现货平台的用户信心与存款流入。CoinDCX称活跃钱包与平台资金未被盗，限制了事件向其他交易所的即时传导，但去向不明资金的相关疑问仍未解开，构成该平台的舆情风险。
updates.market_impact_en: The dispute keeps attention on exchange custody practices and deposit-address hygiene, a channel that can affect user confidence and deposit flows on Indian spot venues. CoinDCX's statement that active wallets and platform funds were untouched limits any immediate read-across to other exchanges, though unresolved questions about the unaccounted funds remain a sentiment risk for the platform.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明
updates.title_en: ⚡️ZachXBT质疑CoinDCX：1580万美元用户存款去向不明

updates.title_zh: 【Coinbase 爱尔兰子公司就客户资金保障问题与爱尔兰央行和解，将支付 325 万欧元罚款】
updates.title_en: 【Coinbase 爱尔兰子公司就客户资金保障问题与爱尔兰央行和解，将支付 325 万欧元罚款】
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase的爱尔兰电子货币子公司将向爱尔兰中央银行支付325万欧元罚款，此前该公司就过去客户资金保障失误的调查达成和解，这些失误包括跨实体混同，以及一个代码错误导致保障账户在2023年和2024年上半年平均短缺约0.54%。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase's Irish e-money subsidiary will pay a €3.25 million fine to the Central Bank of Ireland after settling an investigation into past client-fund safeguarding failures, including cross-entity commingling and a code error that left safeguarding accounts roughly 0.54% short on average in 2023 and the first half of 2024.

updates.title_zh: 区块链调查人员称加密交易所 CoinDCX 就 1600 万美元黑客事件“撒谎”
updates.title_en: Crypto exchange CoinDCX ‘lying’ about $16M hack, say blockchain investigators
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDCX 回应称相关地址是 2025 年 1 月创建、2025 年 7 月已被攻破且不再使用的旧钱包，并将约 1600 万美元损失称为“部分运营损失”；链上调查人员反驳其说法，指其前后表述矛盾，且资金最终流向与旧事件不同的洗钱地址。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX responded that the addresses were old wallets created in January 2025 and compromised in July 2025, claimed they were no longer in use, and described the roughly $16 million as “operational losses”; blockchain investigators disputed the account, citing contradictory statements and laundering routes that differed from last year’s hack.
updates.current_state_zh: 该约 1600 万美元的 CoinDCX 可疑资金外流事件已从 Salus 的初步疑似被盗报告，发展为 CoinDCX 承认旧钱包资金因归集失败形成运营损失、但否认误导，并与链上调查人员就地址归属和资金性质存在公开争议。
updates.current_state_en: The roughly $16 million CoinDCX suspicious outflow has moved from Salus’s initial suspected-theft report to a public dispute: CoinDCX acknowledges operational losses from failed sweeping of old compromised wallets while denying misleading statements, and blockchain investigators contest its account of address ownership and fund movement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blockchain investigators accused CoinDCX of misrepresenting $16M in suspicious on-chain transfers, while the exchange said the wallets were old addresses compromised in July 2025 and no longer in use.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Blockchain investigators accused CoinDCX of misrepresenting $16M in suspicious on-chain transfers, while the exchange said the wallets were old addresses compromised in July 2025 and no longer in use.

updates.title_zh: CoinDCX 迟来承认最新黑客攻击；爱尔兰再次对 Coinbase 开出罚单
updates.title_en: CoinDCX belatedly admits latest hack; Ireland fines Coinbase anew
updates.what_changed_zh:
印度加密货币交易所 CoinDCX 承认发生了一起新的安全入侵事件，但披露时间明显滞后于事件本身。与此同时，爱尔兰央行再次对 Coinbase 的爱尔兰实体开出罚单，相关报道称罚款金额为 325 万欧元（约 360 万美元），事由涉及客户资产保障与外包义务方面的违规。

这两则消息同时指向交易所风险的两大核心议题——托管安全与合规监管，而监管机构正持续收紧这两方面的要求。爱尔兰央行将针对 Coinbase 的执法行动定性为客户保护，并表示：“此次对 Coinbase Ireland 的行动凸显了央行确保客户始终受到保护、并维护金融体系完整性的关注。”

在客户资产保障与外包一案中，针对 Coinbase 的处罚需经爱尔兰高等法院批准后方可生效。Delano 另行报道称，Coinbase Europe 因反洗钱与反恐融资方面的缺失被处以 2150 万欧元罚款，并称这是爱尔兰在加密行业采取的首次执法行动。
updates.what_changed_en:
Indian crypto exchange CoinDCX has acknowledged a new security breach, confirming the incident only after the fact rather than at the time it occurred. Separately, Ireland's central bank issued another penalty against Coinbase's Irish entity, with reports citing a €3.25 million ($3.6 million) fine over safeguarding and outsourcing obligations.

The two disclosures land on the same exchange-risk themes — custody security and regulatory compliance — that supervisors have been tightening. Ireland's central bank framed the Coinbase action as customer protection, stating: "This action against Coinbase Ireland underlines the Central Bank's focus on ensuring that customers are at all times protected and that the integrity of the financial system is maintained."

The Coinbase penalty reported in the safeguarding and outsourcing case requires approval from Ireland's High Court before taking effect. Delano separately reported a €21.5 million penalty against Coinbase Europe for anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing failures, described as Ireland's first enforcement action in the crypto sector.

updates.background_zh: CoinDCX 是一家以印度市场为主的交易所，自称拥有超过 1400 万用户，并表示其上币种类在印度平台中属于最多之列。印度交易所此前已多次遭遇安全事件，其中 WazirX 在 2024 年 7 月披露入侵事件后暂停了加密货币交易。Coinbase 通过受爱尔兰监管的实体在欧洲开展业务，因此爱尔兰央行是其欧盟业务的重要监管机构。
updates.background_en: CoinDCX is an India-focused exchange that describes itself as serving more than 14 million users and says it lists among the widest range of cryptocurrencies available on Indian platforms. Indian exchanges have faced repeated security incidents, including WazirX, which suspended crypto trading in July 2024 after disclosing a breach. Coinbase operates in Europe through Irish-regulated entities, which makes the Central Bank of Ireland a key supervisor for its EU business.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在托管与监管层面，而非价格层面：一家以印度市场为主的交易所延迟披露入侵事件，会引发对用户资产安全的质疑，并可能影响印度卢比市场的交易信心；而爱尔兰央行新的处罚则直接触及 Coinbase 的欧洲牌照范围及其对欧盟客户的合规义务。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through custody and regulatory channels rather than price: a delayed breach disclosure at an India-focused venue raises questions about user asset safety and could affect INR-market trading confidence, while a fresh Central Bank of Ireland sanction touches Coinbase's European licensing perimeter and its compliance obligations for EU customers.

updates.title_zh: 【CoinDCX 确认旧钱包基础设施遭攻击损失 1599 万 USDT，损失由公司承担】
updates.title_en: 【CoinDCX 确认旧钱包基础设施遭攻击损失 1599 万 USDT，损失由公司承担】
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDCX 发布公告确认，10 月 21 日异常活动源于一套已弃用的旧钱包基础设施；该设施曾在 2025 年 7 月 19 日安全事件中遭入侵并停用，但存在未知漏洞。自动归集服务一度失效，导致部分用户误充值至弃用地址的资金累积，最终造成 1599 万 USDT 损失，由公司承担。CoinDCX 称当前交易及钱包系统未受影响，用户资金存放于隔离冷钱包，过去 72 小时充提和交易正常，并将加强遗留系统监控；Salus 首席营销官 Darcy 在评论区称这是“拙劣的谎言”。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX published an announcement confirming that the October 21 abnormal activity originated from deprecated wallet infrastructure. That infrastructure had been compromised in the July 19, 2025 security incident and retired, but contained an unknown vulnerability. An automatic sweeping service failed for a period, allowing funds from users who mistakenly deposited to the deprecated address to accumulate, resulting in a 15.99 million USDT loss that the company will absorb. CoinDCX said current trading and wallet systems were unaffected, user funds are held in isolated cold wallets, deposits, withdrawals and trading operated normally over the past 72 hours, and it will strengthen monitoring of legacy systems; Salus CMO Darcy commented that this is a “clumsy lie.”
updates.current_state_zh: CoinDCX 已正式确认 1599 万 USDT 损失源于被弃用的旧钱包基础设施及自动归集服务失效，并称损失由公司承担、当前系统未受影响；Salus 首席营销官公开质疑其说法。
updates.current_state_en: CoinDCX has formally confirmed that the 15.99 million USDT loss stemmed from deprecated wallet infrastructure and a failed automatic sweeping service, saying it will absorb the loss and that current systems were unaffected; Salus's CMO publicly disputes that account.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CoinDCX confirmed that an attack on deprecated wallet infrastructure caused a 15.99 million USDT loss, which the company will absorb while stating that current trading and wallet systems remain unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_en: CoinDCX confirmed that an attack on deprecated wallet infrastructure caused a 15.99 million USDT loss, which the company will absorb while stating that current trading and wallet systems remain unaffected.
